full_prompt_en: A square hyperreal pop illustration frames a woman's face at extreme close range against a blazing orange background. Her pale face occupies nearly the entire right and center of the image, with only part of the left cheek and eye visible. Two intense blue irises look directly outward; the eye on the viewer's right is fully open and sharply defined, while the left eye sits partly beneath a heavy black sweep of shadow. Long dark lashes, thick sculpted brows, and extended wing-shaped eyeliner make the gaze strongly graphic. A smooth nose falls through the center, catching a soft cream highlight. Glossy scarlet lips fill the lower center, their curved edges sharply separated from the deep black shadow under the lower lip. The hair or dark covering wraps around the face as near-black reflective shapes, leaving a hard diagonal edge down the left cheek and a dark strip at the right. At far left, saturated yellow-orange light flares across an abstract field of curved glowing spots and fine orange strands. The warm glow grazes the left side of the face, while the right cheek remains luminous in cooler cream tones. Highlights in the eyes and lips are small and concentrated, with smooth gradients across skin and abrupt black graphic cuts at the edges. The image is tightly cropped at every side, allowing no setting or body to appear. The overall composition is confrontational and polished, driven by the collision of cool blue eyes, hot orange light, rich red lips, and glossy black framing shapes.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形超写实波普插画把一张女子面庞推到极近距离，背景是炽热橙色。苍白脸部几乎占满右侧和中央，只剩左脸颊及眼睛的一部分可见。两只强烈的蓝色虹膜直视画外；观看者右侧眼睛完整睁开、边界清楚，左眼则部分藏在厚重黑色阴影扫笔下。长而深的睫毛、塑形浓眉和向外伸展的翼状眼线使目光具有强烈图形感。平滑鼻梁穿过中央，接住柔和奶油色高光。光亮猩红嘴唇占据下部中央，弯曲边缘与下唇下方深黑影子清晰分开。头发或深色覆盖物以近黑反光形体围住面庞，在左脸颊划下一道硬斜边，右侧留有深色窄带。最左侧，饱和黄橙光在抽象的弯曲发亮斑块和细橙色线丝上爆开。暖光擦过脸的左侧，右脸颊则保持较冷的奶油色亮度。眼睛与嘴唇里的高光细小集中，肌肤上是平滑渐层，边缘却有突兀黑色图形切口。图像四边都紧密裁切，没有环境或身体出现。整体构图直面观看者且光洁精致，由冷蓝眼睛、热橙光、浓红唇色与光亮黑色框架形体的碰撞驱动。
style_prompt_en: The pop illustration combines hyper-smooth tonal gradients with hard graphic cuts and concentrated glossy highlights. Pale cream and peach areas occupy a large central field, framed by deep reflective black; saturated orange and yellow press in from one side, while small cool blue accents deliver sharp color contrast. Edges switch abruptly from airbrushed softness to nearly vector-like precision. Dark shapes have curved, lacquered surfaces, and bright pinpoints suggest high gloss without scattering highlights everywhere. A single oversized central mass is cropped closely by every boundary, creating immediate visual pressure and a shallow, poster-like space. The hottest color area glows at the edge and grazes the neighboring pale surface, while cooler light keeps the main planes smooth. Fine lines and dense black wedges add directional energy around the brightest focal points. The overall effect is bold, polished, and theatrical, with color-block impact stronger than physical texture.
style_prompt_zh: 这种波普插画把极平滑的明暗渐层与硬朗图形切口、集中的光亮高光结合起来。浅奶油色和桃色占据中央大片区域，由深反光黑色围住；饱和橙黄从一侧压入，少量冷蓝重音形成尖锐色彩反差。边缘从喷绘般柔和骤然切换到近似矢量的精确。深色形体有弯曲漆面感，明亮针点暗示高光泽，却没有把亮点散到处处都是。一个放大的中央团块被四边紧密裁切，形成直接的视觉压力与浅薄、海报般的空间。最热的色域在边缘发光并擦亮邻近浅色表面，较冷光线则让主平面保持平顺。纤细线条和密实黑色楔形在最亮焦点周围添上方向性能量。整体效果大胆、光洁且具有戏剧感，色块冲击力强于物质肌理。
theme_en: An extreme close-up of blue eyes and glossy red lips against orange light
theme_zh: 橙色光芒前蓝眼与亮红唇的极近特写
name: Scott Rohlfs
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
